description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting, which is part of an HTML purification library. The class implements a strategy to fix the nesting of HTML tags in a tokenized representation of HTML content, ensuring that the HTML conforms to allowed nesting and exclusion rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting
classes.description: A class implementing an HTML tag nesting correction strategy within the HTMLPurifier library, extending the base strategy class.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that takes a list of tokens, configuration, and context, then processes the tokens to fix HTML tag nesting according to defined rules. It performs a tree conversion, traverses the tree to validate and correct children, and returns the processed tokens.
